sentences.en: TUTOR: OK
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: SO what I'd like you to do now is to talk to your partner about your presentations on urban planning
sentences.zh: 那么，我现在希望你们和搭档就城市规划主题的展示进行交流。

sentences.en: You should have done most of the reading now, so I'd like you to share your ideas, and talk about the structure of your presentation and what you need to do next
sentences.zh: 你们现在应该已完成大部分阅读任务，因此我希望你们分享各自的想法，讨论展示的结构，以及接下来需要完成的工作。

sentences.en: CARLA: OK Rob
sentences.zh: CARLA: 好的，罗布。

sentences.en: I'm glad we chose quite a specific topic - cities built next to the sea
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们选择了相当具体的话题——建在海边的城市。

sentences.en: It made it much easier to find relevant information
sentences.zh: 这使查找相关信息容易得多。

sentences.en: ROB: Yeah
sentences.zh: ROB: 是啊。

sentences.en: And cities are growing so quickly - I mean, we know that more than half the world's population lives in cities now
sentences.zh: 而且城市正以极快的速度扩张——我的意思是，我们知道目前全球超过一半的人口居住在城市中。

sentences.en: CARLA: Yeah, though that's all cities, not just ones on the coast
sentences.zh: CARLA: 是啊，不过这是指所有城市，并非仅限于沿海城市。

sentences.en: But most of the biggest cities are actually built by the sea, I'd not realised that before
sentences.zh: 但事实上，全球大多数最大的城市实际上都建在海边，这一点我以前并未意识到。

sentences.en: ROB: Nor me
sentences.zh: ROB: 我也没意识到。

sentences.en: And what's more, a lot of them a are built at places where rivers come out into the sea
sentences.zh: 此外，其中许多城市建在河流入海口处。

sentences.en: But apparently this can a be a problem
sentences.zh: 但据称这反而可能引发问题。

sentences.en: CARLA: Why?
sentences.zh: CARLA: 为什么？

sentences.en: ROB: Well, as the city expands, agriculture and industry tend to spread further inland along the rivers, and so agriculture moves even further inland up the river
sentences.zh: ROB: 嗯，随着城市扩张，农业和工业往往沿河流向内陆蔓延，因而农业活动甚至进一步向上游推进。

sentences.en: That's not necessarily a problem, except it means more and more pollutants are discharged into the rivers
sentences.zh: 这本身未必是问题，但意味着越来越多的污染物被排入河流。

sentences.en: CARLA: So these are brought downstream to the cities?
sentences.zh: CARLA: 所以这些污染物便顺流而下，最终抵达城市？

sentences.en: ROB
sentences.zh: ROB。

sentences.en: Right
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Hmm
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Did you read that article about Miami. on the east coast of the USA?
sentences.zh: 你读过那篇关于美国东海岸迈阿密的文章吗？

sentences.en: CARLA: No
sentences.zh: CARLA: 没读过。

sentences.en: ROB: Well, apparently back in the 1950s they built channels to drain away the water in case of flooding
sentences.zh: ROB: 嗯，据称早在20世纪50年代，当地就修建了排水渠，以防洪涝灾害。

sentences.en: CARLA: Sounds sensible
sentences.zh: CARLA: 听起来很合理。

sentences.en: ROB
sentences.zh: ROB。

sentences.en: OPUs Yeah, they spent quite a lot of money on them
sentences.zh: OPUs 是啊，他们在这些工程上投入了相当多的资金。

sentences.en: But what they didn't take into account 023 was global warming
sentences.zh: 但他们当时未将全球变暖因素考虑在内023。

sentences.en: So they built the drainage channels too close to sea level, and now sea levels are rising, they're more or less useless
sentences.zh: 因此，他们把排水渠建得离海平面太近，而如今海平面持续上升，这些排水渠基本上已失去作用。

sentences.en: If there's a lot of rain, the water can't run away, there's nowhere for it to go
sentences.zh: 一旦降雨量很大，雨水无法排出，根本无处可去。

sentences.en: The whole design was faulty
sentences.zh: 整个设计方案存在缺陷。

sentences.en: CARLA: So what are the authorities doing about it now?
sentences.zh: CARLA: 那么当局目前正采取什么措施来应对呢？

sentences.en: ROB: I don't know
sentences.zh: ROB: 我不太清楚。

sentences.en: I did read that they're aiming to stop disposing of waste water into the ocean over the next ten years
sentences.zh: 我确实读到过，他们计划在未来十年内停止向海洋排放废水。

sentences.en: CARLA: But that won't help with flood prevention now, will it?
sentences.zh: CARLA: 但这对当前的防洪工作并无帮助，对吧？

sentences.en: ROB: No
sentences.zh: ROB: 对，没有帮助。

sentences.en: Really they just need to find the money for something to replace the drainage channels, in order to protect against flooding now
sentences.zh: 实际上，他们眼下亟需筹措资金，用新设施替代现有排水渠，以应对当前的洪涝威胁。

sentences.en: But in the long term they need to consider the whole ecosystem
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，他们必须全面考虑整个生态系统。

sentences.en: CARLA: Right
sentences.zh: CARLA: 明白了。

sentences.en: Really, though, coastal cities can't deal with their problems on their own, can they?
sentences.zh: 不过，归根结底，沿海城市单靠自身力量无法解决这些问题，对吗？

sentences.en: I mean, they've got to start acting together at an international level instead of just doing their own thing
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们必须开始在国际层面协同行动，而非各自为政。

sentences.en: ROB
sentences.zh: ROB。

sentences.en: Absolutely
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The thing is, everyone knows what the problems are and environmentalists have a pretty good idea of what we should be doing about them, so they should be able to work together to some extent
sentences.zh: 问题是，大家都知道存在哪些问题，而且环保人士对应该采取什么措施来应对这些问题也有相当明确的想法，因此他们理应在一定程度上展开合作。

sentences.en: But it's going to be a long time before countries come to a decision on what principles they're prepared to abide by
sentences.zh: 但各国就愿意遵守哪些原则达成一致，恐怕还需要很长一段时间。

sentences.en: CARLA: Yes, if they ever do
sentences.zh: CARLA：是啊，如果他们真能达成一致的话。

sentences.en: CARLA: So I think we've probably got enough for our presentation
sentences.zh: CARLA：所以我觉得，我们为演讲准备的内容可能已经够了。

sentences.en: It's only fifteen minutes
sentences.zh: 演讲只有十五分钟。

sentences.en: ROB: OK
sentences.zh: ROB：好的。

sentences.en: So I suppose we'll begin with some general historical background about why coastal cities were established
sentences.zh: 那么，我想我们就从一些关于沿海城市为何建立的总体历史背景开始讲起。

sentences.en: But we don't want to spend too long on that, the other students will already know a bit about it
sentences.zh: 但我们不希望在这部分花太多时间，其他同学对此多少已有所了解。

sentences.en: It's all to do with communications and so on
sentences.zh: 这全都与交通通信等因素有关。

sentences.en: CARLA: Yes
sentences.zh: CARLA：是的。

sentences.en: We should mention some geographical factors, things like wetlands and river estuaries and coastal erosion and so on
sentences.zh: 我们还应提及一些地理因素，比如湿地、河口以及海岸侵蚀等等。

sentences.en: We could have some maps of different cities with these features marked
sentences.zh: 我们可以准备一些标有这些特征的不同城市的地图。

sentences.en: ROB: On a handout you mean?
sentences.zh: ROB：你是说印在讲义上吗？

sentences.en: Or some slides everyone can see?
sentences.zh: 还是做成幻灯片让大家都能看到？

sentences.en: CARLA: Yeah, that'd be better
sentences.zh: CARLA：嗯，那样更好。

sentences.en: ROB: It'd be good to go into past mistakes in a bit more detail
sentences.zh: ROB：深入探讨一下过去犯过的错误，会很有意义。

sentences.en: Did you read that case study of the problems there were in New Orleans with flooding a few years ago?
sentences.zh: 你读过几年前新奥尔良因洪水引发问题的那个案例研究吗？

sentences.en: CARLA: Yes
sentences.zh: CARLA：读过了。

sentences.en: We could use that as the basis for that part of the talk
sentences.zh: 我们可以以此作为演讲这一部分的基础。

sentences.en: I don't think the other students will have read it, but they'll remember hearing about the flooding at the time
sentences.zh: 我想其他同学应该没读过这份案例研究，但他们当时肯定听说过那次洪水事件。

sentences.en: ROB: OK
sentences.zh: ROB：好的。

sentences.en: So that's probably enough background
sentences.zh: 那么，这部分背景信息大概就足够了。

sentences.en: CARLA: So then we'll go on to talk about what action's being taken to deal with the problems of coastal cities
sentences.zh: CARLA：接下来，我们就该谈谈目前正采取哪些行动来应对沿海城市面临的问题。

sentences.en: ROB: OK
sentences.zh: ROB：好的。

sentences.en: What else do we need to talk about?
sentences.zh: 我们还需要谈些什么呢？

sentences.en: Maybe something on future risks, looking more at the long term, if populations continue to grow
sentences.zh: 或许可以谈谈未来的风险，更着眼于长远，比如人口持续增长的情况。

sentences.en: CARLA: Yeah
sentences.zh: CARLA：是的。

sentences.en: We'll need to do a bit of work there, I haven't got much information, have you?
sentences.zh: 这方面我们得再做些功课，我手头资料不多，你呢？

sentences.en: ROB
sentences.zh: ROB。

sentences.en: No
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: We'll need to look at some websites
sentences.zh: 我们需要浏览一些网站。

sentences.en: Shouldn't take too long
sentences.zh: 应该不会花太长时间。

sentences.en: CARLA: OK
sentences.zh: CARLA：好的。

sentences.en: And I think we should end by talking about international implications
sentences.zh: 另外，我认为我们最后应该谈谈国际影响。

sentences.en: Maybe we could ask people in the audience
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以向听众提问。

sentences.en: We've got people from quite lot of different places
sentences.zh: 我们班上有不少来自不同国家的同学。

sentences.en: ROB
sentences.zh: ROB。

sentences.en: That'd be interesting, if we have time, yes
sentences.zh: 如果时间允许的话，那会很有趣，是的。

sentences.en: So now shall we
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们开始吧
